title: Lumi Laurence
body:
Description

Lumi Laurence is the shopkeeper of the River Shop located in the River Caves. Interact with Lumi Laurence to convert raw Lumite into Credits used as the currency in his store.

Trivia

= These messeges below was according to both Lumi and Raffina creator, Ponna.

- Lumi Laurence is a ten thousand years old Ancient Golem that lived in the island before humans have taken over.

- Lumi Laurence likes the wet rocky caves, that's why he built his shop behind the waterfall.

- If Lumi Laurence has hobbies, it would probably be gardening and collecting Lumite.

- Lumi Laurence and Raffina Caldera are supposed to be ex-partners. But Lumi felt like this isn't right because he dislikes magma, so he was the one who broke up and when they see eachother they will start fights.

- Lumi Laurence is male and if comparing to human ages, he's probably around 20 or 30 years old.
